comparison.objective: Open a bottle while continuously holding a spring-return safety loop released.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual contact: hold one control against its spring while operating a rocker.
comparison.success_condition: Body reports successful opening with loop held; releasing the loop prevents opening. No standalone spec or complete numeric scoring rubric is available.
comparison.reason: Its defining ability is simultaneous control actuation, not tool-on-insert alignment, hammer impulse control, fracture, or fragment collection.
